desc: Access, organize and share your photos on GNOME
r: gnome-photos - Access, organize and share your photos on GNOME

gnome-photos is an application to access, organize and share your photos on GNOME. A simple and elegant replacement for using a file manager to deal with photos. Enhance, crop and edit in a snap. Seamless cloud integration is offered through GNOME Online Accounts.
